product.olivetti-pcs40-dx33.summary: The minitower PCS40 with a 33 MHz 486DX.
product.olivetti-pcs40-dx33.history: Olivetti included the PCS40 DX/33 in the PCS30–PCS40 line of 386 and 486 systems. It documented this model as a minitower configuration.
product.olivetti-pcs40-dx33.architecture: Video and storage used expansion cards. With the standard cards installed, 6 of the 8 AT slots remained free in the standard configuration.
product.olivetti-pcs40-dx33.firmware: The board determines which BIOS to look for. The guide documents Harward for 486-VC.
product.olivetti-pcs40-dx33.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-pcs40-dx33.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-pcs40-dx33.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, §39, pp. 39-1–39-3.
